title: a perfect weekend at @The Kennedy Center & @Paper Mill Playhouse ✨ #a...
transcript: there is nothing I love more than a theater road trip so when the Kennedy Center announced that they were doing schmigadoon! as part of their season I knew I'd be heading to Washington DC I've been to DC for theater many many times but this trip we were gonna be there just for the day my friend Sydney had actually never been to DC before so we did a little tour around the mall saw the Washington Monument did all the things it was a little chilly but absolutely beautiful we had dinner at El Centro one of my favorite pre theater spots before heading over to the Kennedy Center for the show now I absolutely love schmigadoon! I've watched the Apple TV series many many times and was devastated when it was cancelled I was a little nervous how it translated to the stage and I should not have been cause it was perfect the show is just filled with references and love for musical theater it's truly note for note season 1 of Schmigadoon! and so getting to see all my favorite songs and choreography onstage was just everything I wanted it's playing through this Sunday February 9th and so many of my friends were in town it was just so fun the next morning we got up at 8:00am to head back up north to the Paper Mill Playhouse in Millburn New Jersey for Mystic Pizza I've never seen the movie I knew that the music was songs from the 80s and 90s but I famously love a good times jukebox musical so I was very excited and truly it was everything I wanted the show to be I keep saying this but it's kind of like if heart of rock and roll and Mamma Mia had a baby and also took place at a pizza shop it's about three girls who all live in Mystic Connecticut and all want bigger lives for themselves but don't exactly know what that means the book is by Sandy Rustin who wrote ‘the cottage’ so it was really funny and I really just loved this whole cast and getting to see deanna on stage was so special she is just such a star and I am so glad I got to see her we are leaving Mystic Pizza we’re done exactly what I wanted I loved every minute of it we are jukebox musical girlies that's my brand and that was so much fun everything it's a goofy good time you need to come see it yeah multiple times I'm gonna see it again I don't care ah the star of mystic pizza
classificationReason: Creator describes attending Schmigadoon! at the Kennedy Center as part of a theater road trip, shares first-hand opinions ('it was perfect', 'getting to see all my favorite songs and choreography onstage was just everything I wanted'), and provides specific show details. Clear first-hand attendance and positive review.
